title: Humility and Holiness
reading:
God dwells with the contrite. Holiness is not cold perfection; it is surrendered brokenness before God.

Humility is the soil where holiness grows.
reflection: Do I equate holiness with performance? When was the last time I wept over my sin? Is my repentance quick or resistant?
abide: God inhabits the contrite heart. Not the polished one. Not the impressive one. The broken and surrendered one. You are welcome here.
